VOCABULARY Phrasal verbs
A phrasal verb is a verb - put, throw, take, etc. - plus a
particle like up, off, out, down, etc. Sometimes they are
used instead of single word verbs. Phrasal verbs are
more colloquial and informal than single word verbs.
